scripts.dev: node scripts/dev/preflight.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up
scripts.dev:build: node scripts/dev/preflight.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up --build
scripts.dev:gpu: node scripts/dev/preflight.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.gpu.yml --env-file .env up
scripts.dev:obs: node scripts/dev/preflight.mjs && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.observability.yml --env-file .env up -d && node scripts/dev/observabilidade-pronta.mjs
scripts.obs:down: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.observability.yml --env-file .env stop grafana prometheus loki alloy
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter api test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.engine:setup: cd apps/engine && mix deps.get && mix ecto.create && mix ecto.migrate
